import json,tempfile,os
from pathlib import Path
def solve(path,value):
 text=json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False);target=Path(path)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=target.parent)as folder:
  temporary=Path(folder)/'payload';temporary.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8');os.replace(temporary,target)
